create_BootstrappedDQN: create a BootstrappedDQN instance with an ensemble Q-value network and discrete action space
learn_batch_BootstrappedDQN: learn from a TransitionWithBootstrapMaskBatch by computing MSE loss across ensemble members and updating Q-networks
act_BootstrappedDQN: act by selecting greedy actions from the current ensemble member or exploring via DeepExploration
reset_BootstrappedDQN: reset the DeepExploration module to resample the epistemic index for a new episode
compare_BootstrappedDQN: compare two BootstrappedDQN instances and return a string describing differences in hyperparameters and network weights
